name: diosidecar
description: A desktop diagram editor with an embedded ACP agent and live canvas editing
author: DioSidecar contributors

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix agent ci && npm run build:agent
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:agent && electron-builder --config agent/electron-builder-mac-local.json --publish never
scripts.release:mac: npm run build:agent && electron-builder --config agent/electron-builder-release.json --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:arm64: npm run build:agent && electron-builder --config agent/electron-builder-release.json --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:x64: npm run build:agent && electron-builder --config agent/electron-builder-release.json --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build:agent && electron-builder --config agent/electron-builder-release.json --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:linux: npm run build:agent && electron-builder --config agent/electron-builder-release.json --linux --x64 --publish never
